website.data: Roofing OnTop & Construction Home About Services Residential Commercial ROT Gives Back Blog Contact Log In Review ROT Click for sound ONE NAME. EVERY SEASON. ALL EXTERIORS. Complimentary OnTop Total Exterior Assessment Welcome to Roofing OnTop & Construction We earned trust protecting North Texas homes and businesses one roof at a time. As customers asked for more, we answered. Built on years of craftsmanship, integrity, and community care, Roofing OnTop & Construction now delivers the same trusted approach across the entire exterior. Today, we provide dependable, year-round exterior services for both residential and commercial properties. Schedule Your Complimentary Total Exterior Assessment Today! Patio Covers + Pergolas + Outdoor Living Fences + Patio Decking + Wood Structures Roof Inspections + Storm Damage Followup + Repairs Pavers + Masonry + Concrete + Outside Fireplace Exterior Painting + Staining + Power Washing Gutters + Fascia + Windows & Trim Schedule Your OnTop Exterior Assessment Today! Our Roofing & Exterior Project Process is Simple and Prompt Contact Us Not sure if recent weather or normal wear has affected your property? Or simply planning an exterior upgrade? Contact us and our experienced project managers will take the time to understand your needs, answer your questions, and schedule a visit to your home or business. We’re here to guide you through the process and help you make confident decisions for your exterior. Contact Us Exterior Inspection Once we visit your property, we’ll perform a thorough exterior inspection tailored to your specific needs — roofing, gutters, paint, fencing, patios, drainage, and more. We’ll review what’s in good condition, identify any areas of concern, and explain next steps clearly. If insurance is involved, we can help document findings and guide you through the process from start to finish. Insurance Consultation If your project involves storm damage or an insurance claim, we help guide you through that process. Our team works with you to gather documentation, review coverage, and coordinate with your insurance adjuster when needed. We ensure nothing is overlooked so your exterior repairs or restoration are properly addressed. Project Scheduled & Completed Once details are finalized, we schedule your project and coordinate materials, timelines, and skilled crews. From minor repairs to full exterior renovations, our team completes the work with precision, professionalism, and respect for your property — delivering results you can trust. Final Walkthrough After the project is complete, your project manager returns to walk the property with you. We review the completed work together, answer any remaining questions, and ensure everything meets both our standards and yours before we consider the job finished. Continued Support Our commitment doesn’t end when the project does. We remain available for future exterior needs, maintenance questions, or follow-up services. And if you enjoyed working with us, reviews and referrals help local businesses like ours continue serving North Texas communities. Community Members We believe in being a part of our communities we serve helping with insurance claims, information about roof and replacements, damage and much more. Proudly serving McKinney, Allen, Plano, Frisco, Anna, Melissa, and Surrounding Areas. Proudly Voted Best Roofing Company! We’re honored to be consistently recognized by our communities and industry for our professionalism, craftsmanship, and service. These awards reflect the hard work our team puts into every project — and the trust our clients place in us. Thank you to our past, present, and future clients for allowing us to serve you. Did You Know? Roofing OnTop & Energy is part of an elite 2% of roofers in DFW recognized as an Owens Corning Preferred Contractor . With over 6,000–12,000 roofers in the area, fewer than 240 earn this trusted title. Why? Because OC only backs contractors who meet high standards for licensing, insurance, reputation, and workmanship. In a market full of “Chuck in a truck” roofers, we’re proud to be the real deal— proven, professional, and preferred . data.name: Roofing OnTop & Construction
data.address: 207 E Virginia St STE 212, McKinney, TX 75069

reviews.text: Great response and work quality.  I had shopped a couple places and most were priced ok but wanted to upgrade/increase service-replacement.  After further consideration and not only appreciate the honesty but explanation as to why we didn't need to perform the other services recommended by other co.'s.  This was my 2nd time getting the same work completed knowing the issue so I was appreciate with the non hard sell approach.  If you want honest good craftmanship, you've arrived.
reviews.author: Stephen Prescott

reviews.text: Working with David and Andy was a bliss. They were both very knowledgeable about the kind of roofs and materials available in the market and they recommend the best. They were very flexible and setting up appointments from the beginning to the end was of the process was easy and painless. We got the roof that we wanted and we are happy customers. I would recommend Roofing on Top for anyone who needs a new roof. David the owner was very kind and understanding and he now feels like family. Good job Roofing on Top. Sending more business your way.
reviews.author: Jane Wangari

reviews.text: I had a great experience with roof on top. They repaired a roof leak and the sheetrock from the water leak. The guys were very professional and knowledgeable about what they were doing. They kept me informed on the steps up to completion. They cleaned the area and the finished job was fantastic!! I would highly recommend them. Thank you David for having a heart for what you do.
reviews.author: Cynthia Breeden

reviews.text: Roofing On Top is led with real professionalism and integrity. David is knowledgeable, communicates clearly, and takes pride in delivering quality work. Based on my interactions with him and the way he carries his business, it’s easy to see why so many people trust his company for their roofing needs. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Keith Ford

reviews.text:
Recently had to replace my roof and gutters due to hail damage and the Texas weather. Andy was a great team leader. The crew were on time. Cleaned up after beyond what I was expecting.
I would recommend this company anytime. Going local for a big job gave me comfort. I also give Suzanne 5 stars. She kept me posted and informed about the entire process.
reviews.author: Susan

reviews.text:
Randomly ended up with a leak in our roof that was dripping down into our AC units in the attic. Experience with the team was top notch from start to finish. Contacted very quickly. Communicated directly with the team member that assessed the situation and took pictures. Kept in the loop as the team evaluated the best steps, and it turned out to be a simple fix. Never upsold into things we didn’t need. Never told “oh you need a new roof” as I’ve been told before (roof is 7 years old). Felt zero pressure. The owner himself came and did the repair. The team was working around holidays and stayed on top of everything.

This time was a small repair, but we know the only company we are calling next time for anything we need roof, gutter, or other exterior. Thank you!!
reviews.author: Hunter Crittenden

reviews.text: We had a great experience working with Roofing OnTop. From customer service to execution, the team did an amazing job. They were kind, knowledgeable, and hard working. Shout out to Brandon and Christian for removing our old fence, and getting up a quality fence in a short amount of time. I’d definitely recommend this company to my friends and family!
reviews.author: LM

reviews.text:
David is stand up guy! I like the transparency, honesty and great communication. His team does excellent work and craftsmanship.
I highly recommend roofing on top for all your roofing and solar needs.
reviews.author: O Garza
